verdicts.reason: A keeps the original layout intact. The 'YOUR EFFICIENT' kicker sits centred between its small quote marks above ENERGY USE, and the illustration keeps its proportions. Its flaw is that it only widens the canvas without rearranging anything: the white text panel and the blue strips on each side stretch out and leave dead space, while the small kicker stays tiny. B is the same layout but breaks the kicker. The left quote glyph is blown up into a large grey double-arrow that butts against 'YOUR', so the kicker is lopsided and off the axis of the centred headline. That is a visible rendering or brand defect A doesn't have.
